caption: The drawing depicts a group of people gathered around a central figure who is carrying a large wooden cross. The central figure is dressed in blue and white clothing with a crown of thorns on his head, being supported by others. Several men in the background, wearing red or blue garments and elaborate headdresses, are either holding the cross or gesturing towards the central figure. On the left side, there is a figure on horseback, partially visible, with a red and blue garment. At the front, two figures kneel—the one on the left in a light brown or beige robe, the other in red—reaching up towards the central figure. On the right side, one woman in a blue robe with red accents and a white head covering stands beside another woman in a brown robe and white veil. The background is mostly dark, featuring black and brown tones, which accentuates the figures in the foreground. The composition is crowded, with overlapping figures filling the entire scene, and the colors used are earthy tones with dominating reds, blues, browns, and whites.
title: Station of the Cross No. 6: "Veronica Renders Service to Jesus"
